source_evidence: You can verify the registration of both publicly traded and non-traded REITs through the SEC’s EDGAR system. You can also use EDGAR to review a REIT’s annual and quarterly reports as well as any offering prospectus.
question: How can an investor use EDGAR when researching a REIT?
answer: EDGAR can be used to check whether a publicly traded or non-traded REIT is registered with the SEC and to review its annual and quarterly reports and any offering prospectus.
